name: Manchebo Beach Resort & Spa
ref_sources: OSM footprints along J.E. Irausquin Blvd; colours and massing matched to Wikimedia Commons photos of Eagle Beach (fofoti, palapas, La Cabana, Manchebo) and Esri World Imagery roof colours. Mapillary street-level coverage of this boulevard was the intended photo reference; the public API refused unauthenticated requests, so openly licensed Commons photos of the same beach were used instead. Geometry and sign textures are original.
